core_obligations: Construct the resolution termwise (proof lines 3214-3224): the author constructs by recursion on the degrees a complex K^bullet with flat terms mapping quasi-isomorphically and termwise surjectively onto G^bullet, choosing the terms as direct sums of flat modules surjecting onto the relevant kernels.

Verify the properties (proof lines 3224-3230): the construction gives flatness of the terms and termwise surjectivity, and the map is a quasi-isomorphism because the kernels are dealt with degree by degree; the complex is K-flat by the preceding results of the section.
proof_roadmap: Build the resolution degree by degree using surjections from flat modules.
Check flatness of the terms and termwise surjectivity of the map.
Use the preceding results to conclude K-flatness and the quasi-isomorphism property.
difficulty_reason: The lemma produces, for an arbitrary complex of modules on a ringed site, a K-flat complex with flat terms mapping quasi-isomorphically and termwise surjectively onto it (statement lines 3206-3212). The proof constructs the resolution degree by degree, choosing each term as a direct sum of flat modules surjecting onto the relevant kernel (proof lines 3214-3224), and then verifies flatness of the terms, termwise surjectivity and the quasi-isomorphism property, K-flatness following from the results of the section (proof lines 3224-3230). The non-formal content is the recursive construction. The claim is H2: one construction plus one verification.
